svg.title: IBM Sterling Order Management editions, counted by order line
svg.desc: The four IBM Sterling Order Management editions as IBM's pricing page states them: Essentials and Standard, delivered as SaaS, per line monthly; Professional and Enterprise, available on containers, per line. A cloud stands for the SaaS editions and a stack of containers for the others.
